prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. depth.jpg, segmentation.jpg and pose.jpg are the same 5 frames rendered as a monocular depth map (brighter = nearer to the camera wearer), an instance segmentation map (coloured masks with class labels), and a body/hand skeleton map (yellow = body, magenta = hands) on black. Look at all four images. For EACH of the three maps, describe the spatial understanding that map supports, using the RGB strip for context: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Say what each map shows that is hard to see in the RGB alone, and where the map looks unreliable. Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"depth": "...", "segmentation": "...", "pose": "..."} with 3-5 sentences each.

descriptions.depth: The monocular depth map depicts an outdoor sloped muddy terrain rising from the very bright foreground (roughly 1 to 2 metres in front of and below the camera wearer, nothing within arm's reach of the wearer) up toward a dark background treeline over 15 to 20 metres away. In the mid-ground on the left at approximately 4 to 5 metres distance, a standing woman faces and looks toward the camera wearer while holding a vertical stick or tool handle in her left hand within her arm's reach (about 0.3 metres to her right) and standing about 0.8 metres to the right of a bucket resting on the ground. Behind and above her on the earthen mound stands a large tree trunk roughly 8 to 10 metres from the camera wearer, which is partially cropped at the top of the frame and completely out of view by the fifth frame. Across the five frames, the foreground mud remains nearest while the woman's silhouette shifts downward in frames 2 and 3 and sharply upward toward the top-left in frame 5 as the camera wearer pitches the head downward and tilts right, maintaining a roughly constant 4 to 5 metre separation. This map clearly separates the depth planes of the thin tool handle, the bucket, the mid-ground earthen ridge, and the distant tree canopy that blend into the similarly coloured brown soil in RGB, though it is unreliable in frames 2 and 3 where sky pixels between tree branches are assigned falsely bright mid-range depths and around the woman's feet where her lower legs merge smoothly into the ground plane.
descriptions.segmentation: The instance segmentation map isolates a single pink mask labeled 'person' in the mid-ground left, situated roughly 4 to 5 metres in front of the camera wearer in an open muddy area where nothing is within the camera wearer's arm's reach. In the RGB context, this person stands upright facing and looking toward the camera wearer, positioned between a bucket about 0.8 metres to her right (image left) and a vertical wooden tool handle held within her left arm's reach about 0.3 metres to her left (image right), with a sloped dirt bank and trees behind and above her. Across the five frames, the person mask stays roughly constant in pixel area—indicating neither approach nor retreat—while shifting slightly downward and rightward in frames 1 to 3 and then upward toward the upper-left in frames 4 and 5 due to the camera wearer's head motion. The segmentation map provides a crisp silhouette of the woman's torso, wrapped garment, and bent right elbow against the textured brown soil that otherwise camouflagesthem in RGB. However, the map is unreliable for broader scene parsing because it fails to segment the bucket, the held stick within her reach, or the background trees, and the 'person' label box slightly occludes the top of her head while her ankles and feet are truncated at the bottom of the mask.
descriptions.pose: The pose map renders a single yellow 2D body skeleton in the mid-ground left at roughly 4 to 5 metres from the camera wearer, with no skeletons or hands detected within the camera wearer's own arm's reach in the foreground. The symmetrically open shoulder and hip keypoints confirm that the woman is facing and looking directly toward the camera wearer, with her right elbow bent outward to place her right hand on her hip and her left arm extended downward and slightly right to grip the top of the vertical stick within her arm's reach (about 0.3 metres from her body, while the unrepresented bucket sits 0.8 metres to the image left). Her feet keypoints rest at the bottom of the skeleton on the sloped ground, which rises behind and above her toward the background trees that are partly cropped at the top edge. Across the five frames, the skeleton maintains the same frontal stance and limb configuration while translating downward in frames 2 and 3 and upward to the top-left by frame 5 as the camera wearer tilts the camera downward and rightward. The skeleton reveals the exact joint articulation of her legs and hips beneath her loose clothing and tracks her head orientation more explicitly than RGB alone, but it is unreliable in omitting all magenta hand keypoints despite both hands being visible and in offering no spatial representation of the held stick, nearby bucket, or surrounding terrain.
